Home / About

Built to keep facilities running, 365 days a year.

Zevoria HRMS & Material Solutions is a trusted leader in Integrated Facility Management (IFM), delivering cost-effective, innovative and sustainable solutions across Pakistan since 2019.

With a robust nationwide presence including Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad, we offer standardised facility services under a single contract — simplifying operations for our clients.

Integrated Facility Management means the building is treated as one system rather than a set of unrelated jobs. The team that cleans your floors, the technician who services the air conditioning, the supervisor who checks safety and the supply of consumables all sit under the same agreement and the same standard of delivery.

Backed by decades of collective industry expertise, we adhere to international standards through ISO-compliant frameworks for Quality, Environment, and Health & Safety. We are the preferred facility partner for a diverse portfolio, including commercial buildings, industrial sites, shopping malls, hospitals, diplomatic missions and educational institutes.

Our service model is built on flexibility, offering dedicated on-site management and 24/7 mobile technical support. Whether it is specialised cleaning or complex technical maintenance, our professionally trained teams ensure your facility operates seamlessly 365 days a year.

Home / Services

Seven service lines, one accountable team.

We provide comprehensive facility management, maintenance and housekeeping services to ensure clean, safe and well-maintained environments for offices, hospitals, factories, commercial buildings and institutions. Take the full package, or only the lines you need.

01

Facility & operation maintenance

We manage the day-to-day operations of facilities, including coordination of services, utilities management, safety supervision and overall building administration to ensure smooth and efficient operations.

In practice that means one team keeping track of everything happening in the building: who is on site, what is due, what has failed and what needs ordering — reported back to you through a single on-site manager instead of a dozen separate vendors.

What it covers

  • Coordination of all on-site services
  • Utilities management
  • Safety supervision
  • Overall building administration
  • Dedicated on-site management
  • Everything under a single contract
02

HR outsourcing & recruitment

Providing skilled manpower, staffing and recruitment solutions — sourcing the people your operation needs and, where required, managing them on site so headcount does not become your administration.

This line can run on its own for organisations that only need manpower, or sit alongside the facility services so that the same team is recruited, trained and supervised to one standard.

What it covers

  • Skilled manpower supply
  • Staffing for site-based roles
  • Recruitment solutions
  • Professionally trained teams
  • Supervision by on-site management
  • Available in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad
03

HVAC operation & maintenance

Our maintenance services cover electrical, plumbing, HVAC (air conditioning), mechanical works and general repairs. We ensure that all equipment and infrastructure remain in excellent working condition to avoid downtime and costly breakdowns.

Air conditioning is usually the system a building can least afford to lose, so technical cover does not stop at the end of the working day — 24/7 mobile technical teams respond when something fails outside normal hours.

What it covers

  • HVAC and air conditioning operation
  • Electrical works
  • Plumbing
  • Mechanical works
  • General repairs
  • 24/7 mobile technical response
04

Housekeeping & janitorial services

We deliver professional cleaning, sanitation, waste management, floor care, washroom cleaning, and complete indoor and outdoor cleaning services to maintain a healthy, hygienic and pleasant environment.

Teams are professionally trained and placed on a schedule that matches how your building is actually used — daily routines during operating hours, deeper specialised cleaning when the building is quiet.

What it covers

  • Professional cleaning and sanitation
  • Waste management
  • Floor care
  • Washroom cleaning
  • Indoor and outdoor cleaning
  • Specialised cleaning on request
05

Integrated pest management

Treatment and control programmes for commercial and domestic premises, delivered as part of your facility contract or as a standalone service.

Services offered

  • Disinfection services
  • Termite control services
  • Rat treatment
  • Commercial & domestic fumigation services
  • Cockroach, bedbug and mosquito control
06

General order supplies (GOS)

The consumables a working building gets through every month, supplied through the same channel as your services — so the materials your teams use are ordered, delivered and accounted for in one place.

Supply categories

  • Office stationery & essentials
  • Pantry, grocery & kitchen items
  • IT & computer accessories
  • Electrical & electronic items
  • Janitorial & cleaning supplies
07

Solar panel & glass cleaning services

We provide professional solar panel and glass cleaning services to remove dust, dirt, bird droppings and other debris, ensuring improved solar panel efficiency and maintaining a clean, clear and presentable appearance of glass surfaces and walls.

Dust build-up is a real cost on a solar installation and a visible one on a glass facade; scheduled cleaning protects both the output and the appearance of the building.

What it covers

  • Solar panel cleaning
  • Removal of dust, dirt and bird droppings
  • Improved panel efficiency
  • Glass surface cleaning
  • Wall and facade cleaning
  • Scheduled or one-off visits

Working with us

A single contract that grows with the account.

Accounts rarely start with everything. Most begin with one requirement — housekeeping, a technical contract, a team of staff — and widen as trust is built, adding service lines and sites to the same agreement rather than a new vendor each time.

That is what the single-contract model is for: the scope can change without the paperwork, the point of contact or the standard of delivery changing with it.

Common questions

Before you get in touch.

Which cities do you cover?

We have a robust nationwide presence across Pakistan, including Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad. Our registered office is in Korangi Township, Karachi.

Can all the services sit under one contract?

Yes. That is the basis of our model — standardised facility services delivered under a single contract, which simplifies operations, procurement and accountability for your team.

Can we take only one service, such as manpower or pest control?

Yes. Any of the seven service lines can be taken on its own, and further lines can be added to the same agreement later as your requirement grows.

What happens if something fails outside working hours?

Our service model includes 24/7 mobile technical support alongside dedicated on-site management, so technical teams can respond and your facility keeps operating 365 days a year.

Do you supply materials as well as services?

Yes. General Order Supplies covers office stationery and essentials, pantry, grocery and kitchen items, IT and computer accessories, electrical and electronic items, and janitorial and cleaning supplies.

What standards do you work to?

We adhere to international standards through ISO-compliant frameworks for Quality, Environment, and Health & Safety, applied across the sites we manage.

How does an engagement start?

With a site survey. We visit your facility to understand the scope and hours required, then issue a written scope and proposal before mobilising a team.
